results.title: British jets join French nuclear exercise for first time, France says
results.description: In a significant show of solidarity, British and French military jets have engaged in a collaborative exercise aimed at enhancing their nuclear capabilities amid rising threats in Europe. Named 'Rummy', this operation involved British Typhoons and French Rafales simulating a nuclear strike. French officials stress the critical nature of their nuclear partnership in bolstering European security, underscoring their dedicated efforts to peace through robust deterrence strategies.
